2610.02824.title: MetaRubric: Learning to Reward for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
2610.02824.paper_summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends reward-driven optimization to open-ended tasks by assigning partial credit to individual response requirements. However, rubric judges can assign a high criterion score even when the information or action it requires is absent from the response, a failure mode we term Vacuous Credit. Such awards persist after the required information is removed and can reverse the sign of a response's GRPO advantage. To address this problem, we introduce MetaRubric, which alternates evidence-aware policy optimization with response-guided rubric adaptation. We construct counterfactual counterparts by changing one task-relevant fact in each prompt. During policy optimization, credit is assigned only when the response contains sufficient evidence to satisfy the required rubric criterion. After each policy-optimization stage, current policy responses guide revisions to original and counterfactual criteria while preserving the meaning of the original prompt's initial rubric as interpreted under each prompt's facts. We also adapt criterion weights at stage boundaries to better address observed policy errors. Across multiple backbones, MetaRubric improves PubMedQA accuracy by 6.00--20.40 percentage points over static-judge GRPO, with further gains on HealthBench-Hard and two multimodal medical benchmarks.
2610.02824.paper_summary_zh: 基於評分標準的強化學習通過為個別反應要求分配部分信用，將獎勵驅動的優化擴展到開放式任務。然而，評分標準的評審即使在所需的信息或行動缺失的情況下也能給予高標準分數，這種失敗模式我們稱之為空洞信用。這樣的獎勵在所需信息被移除後仍然存在，並且可以反轉反應的GRPO優勢的符號。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了MetaRubric，它交替進行基於證據的政策優化和反應引導的評分標準調整。我們通過在每個提示中改變一個與任務相關的事實來構建反事實對應物。在政策優化過程中，只有當反應包含足夠的證據來滿足所需的評分標準時，才會分配信用。在每個政策優化階段之後，當前政策的反應指導對原始和反事實標準的修訂，同時保留原始提示在每個提示的事實下解釋的初始評分標準的意義。我們還在階段邊界調整標準權重，以更好地解決觀察到的政策錯誤。在多個基礎模型中，MetaRubric使PubMedQA的準確率比靜態評審的GRPO提高了6.00--20.40個百分點，並在HealthBench-Hard和兩個多模態醫學基準上進一步提升。
2610.02824.author: Yuxuan Fan et.al.
